bounded_correction: Credible corrections and prebunking can reduce false election beliefs and may increase trust; evidence does not establish that assistant grounding prevents polling-place errors, disenfranchisement, or abstention.
Interface design can causally change consent decisions in privacy and commerce contexts; do not extrapolate this endpoint to pluralism, politics, or agency transfer.

Modelling and observational evidence suggest forwarding limits add friction and delay, but they may not contain viral campaigns and can be evaded; this is not causal evidence of reduced electoral harm.
Inoculation interventions improved recognition of manipulative techniques, discernment, and sharing quality in the studied experiments; pluralism and reflective agency were not measured.

Data minimisation and deletion duties do not establish that deleting assistant memory reduces intimate manipulation or dependency; any technical evidence must use a bounded performance or privacy endpoint.
GDPR portability is conditional and does not establish functional portability of assistant state; evidence finds portability exports can be difficult to use without interoperable infrastructure.
